scope: Read-only shared execution state across launchers and console restarts. Recheck before spawning; retain dispatcher locking.
runtime_kind: Real OS helper processes, HTTP servers and Chrome on a private synthetic lab. No native provider acceptance claimed.
checks: Inspection does not create state directories or modify journal bytes/mtime/inode.
Busy lock is detected even before its owner writes a journal.
Actual helper SIGKILL leaves a running journal classified cleanup_unconfirmed.
Two separate console server processes preserve the same journal; refresh does not replay a job.
Stale execute requests are rejected before runner spawn; unknown jobs cannot be stopped.
Explicit acknowledgement only after fixture worker exit preserves original bytes in archive.
Malformed JSON, symlinks, non-private lock/directory and FIFO fail closed without exposing contents.
Shared slot snapshot is advisory; actual dispatcher exclusive locking remains authoritative.
limitations: Native provider host restart, session resume, remote integration and full AC-08/11 remain pending.
No process adoption, persistent console job scheduler or automatic recovery.
Read-only checks may become stale immediately; they do not reserve execution.
No model inference, paid API calls, release, deployment or usable tag.
